title: claimspec v1 — project configuration (testguard.config.json)
description: How this project's tests run, so a plain `testguard probe` (a hook, a CI line, an agent) runs them correctly without flags (#301). Every key is a default for the command-line option of the same meaning; a flag, then the environment variable where one exists, wins over the file. Only options that describe HOW the tests run belong here: nothing selects WHAT is probed and nothing shapes output. A value from the file is held to exactly the rules of the flag it stands for (a `confirm` below 3 is provisional). An unknown key or a wrong type is refused, never ignored.

runnerCmd.description: --runner-cmd: a custom command; must contain {files} and {out}. Run as an argv, never through a shell.

python.description: --python: a bare command looked up on PATH (python3), or a path relative to the project directory that stays inside the repository (.venv/bin/python). TESTGUARD_PYTHON wins over it.

nodeModules.description: --node-modules: a directory relative to the project directory that stays inside the repository (../node_modules in a workspace package). TESTGUARD_NODE_MODULES wins over it.

typecheck.description: --typecheck: true runs the project's own tsc; a string is the command (an argv, never a shell). Applies to probe and claims --check-anchors. There is no flag that turns it off: --no-config does.

confirm.description: --confirm. Below 3 the run is provisional, exactly as with the flag, and the warning names this file.

budget.description: --budget: wall clock per run, in milliseconds.
